---
title: "9: The Impact of Judicial Decisions"
---

Do court rulings actually change anything? This week we examine the impact of judicial decisions on policy, behaviour, the economy and public opinion. We pay particular attention to whether and when rulings move public opinion, sometimes in unintended directions.
